conditions.representation: number CDF8,signed symmetric J,real orthogonal U
conditions.initialization: same original qualified J/U at eta=0;NOT saved trial2 U or any optimized endpoint
conditions.per_new_eta: original J initialization,then exactly two successive same-array Newton-CG refinements
conditions.purpose: one qualified Armijo advancement experiment;no full convergence/performance comparison

algorithm.inner: UNCHANGED verified same-array Newton-CG,maxiter1000/xtol1e-12;original J at every eta,then exactly2 refinements
algorithm.admission: UNCHANGED J<=1e-5 plus margin,final-pair U-shift<=1e-6,original head/nullspace/tail injectivity,independent state/value/chain/nonincrease gates;raw flags independent
algorithm.proposed_change: Replace SciPy BFGS/Wolfe abort-on-unqualified outer with ONE bounded qualified-only Armijo steepest-descent step;do not call BFGS or update its Hessian
algorithm.direction: d=-g0,only from numerically admitted original eta0;do not use rejected/unqualified derivatives
algorithm.initial_alpha: min(1,1.01/norm(g0)),same first-query scaling as SciPy1.14.1 BFGS with H0=I;zero/nonfinite/non-descent:STOP
algorithm.trial_schedule: alpha_i=alpha0*0.5**i,i=0..7;no interpolation/restart or extra trial outside this registered schedule
algorithm.rejectable: Only J_UNQUALIFIED and REDUCED_GRADIENT_UNQUALIFIED of an unaccepted trial;record without supplying fictitious F or gradient;then try next registered alpha
algorithm.acceptance: Trial independently numerically admitted AND true evaluated F_trial<=F0+1e-4*alpha*dot(g0,d) AND F_trial<F0;qualified gradient finite and same eta;at most1 accepted U update
algorithm.correctness: Any source/input/nonfinite/chain/value/raw/orthogonality/progress mismatch:immediate dependent STOP,never halve and continue
algorithm.numerical_limits: point-budget exception or rounded zero step:explicit STOP;all8 trials exhausted:no accepted update;initial unqualified:no trial search
algorithm.mathematical_scope: Observed Armijo descent on numerical envelope samples,NOT strong Wolfe,not certified true reduced-gradient accuracy or global convergence

numerical_allowances.rank_rule: existing head rank LD*d-(LD-1),only U-independent universal head gauges;extra/ambiguous null refused;tail injectivity;no pseudoinverse/drop/ridge

calls.inner_J_solve: <=27,3 per initial/trial eta;all vg/Hessian/raw diagnostics included and actual counters saved
calls.precision_state: <=18,2 per eta;existing extended/binary64 independent J/U state
calls.reduced_admission: <=9,unchanged qualification plus scalar physical/chart pair norms and delta-J Frobenius from already computed arrays;no extra gradient/Hessian query
calls.export: 1,already computed diagnostic terminal only;DF budget remains null

execution_order: outer_driver:initial3-solve/2-state/admission;then up to8 registered alpha trials,each same3-solve/2-state/admission;reject qualification only;accept at most1 qualified Armijo point
not_measured: gauge decomposition of real delta J
outputs: raw x0/x/J/z/jac/W and pre-step/accepted point records for every inner call
solver statuses and actual evaluation/iteration counters
both precision states and all admission gates for each eta
pair physical/chart shifts and delta-J norm,not certified error bounds
trial eta/alpha and qualification/rejection reasons;unqualified objective is null in search decision record,not assigned a fake value
actual qualified Armijo operands and accepted eta if any
terminal and rejected trial identities kept separately
SOURCE/contract copies,call journal,resources,failure partial if any,STOP

outcomes.accepted: QUALIFIED_ARMIJO_STEP_ACCEPTED:one numerical qualified descent step only,not full convergence/performance
outcomes.initial_unqualified: No search;save diagnostic initial pair,not a reduced-qualified terminal
outcomes.raw_precision_loss: Preserve flags;neither automatically qualifies nor rejects J/reduced point

forbidden: change inner solver to trust-exact or offset objective in molecular science
use unknown gradient/NaN/penalty/zero-gradient placeholders for rejected trials
more than8 trial points or1 accepted update
extra refinement/retry/resume/old run restart or leftover36-unit reuse

authorization: PROPOSAL ONLY;user/researchC must decide the BFGS/Wolfe-to-one-Armijo-step policy change and explicitly permit this fresh60-unit scope. No approval proof/record/grant required
